items.title: Fall Asleep on the Silk Road | A Night Camel Caravan Sleep Story (48 Min)
items.description:
Leave a quiet oasis town at the edge of the desert and travel west with a camel caravan along the Silk Road, about twelve hundred years ago. Watch the camels being loaded with silk, pass the old Jade Gate and its silent watchtowers, listen to the slow caravan bell under a sky full of stars, rest beside a desert well, and hear a little music by the fire. Softly narrated, with moonlit dunes and a long, restful ending.
